situation: Placing large model-serving pods on GPU clusters.
decision: One model-serving pod per GPU group; pin large-model pods with node affinity and taints; cache model weights on node-local NVMe; scale from queue depth and time-to-first-token, not CPU.
reasoning_physics: A large model co-located on the same GPU as unrelated work contends for VRAM/bandwidth; taints+affinity isolate it. Node-local NVMe avoids re-pulling weights (hundreds of GB) per restart. TTFT and queue depth are the latency signals that scale decisions; CPU is a poor proxy.
